source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"
And also enter "Server Health" -> "Sensor Reading"

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor Reading & Threshold is human reable and match with spec.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sensor get 'SEL_InfoErr_Full' 2>&1; echo ---SDR-FALLBACK---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sdr elist 2>&1 | head -100
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: returns FULL raw `ipmitool (OOB lanplus) sensor get "<SENSOR>"` reading + threshold; user judges (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES treats `SEL_InfoErr_Full` as a literal unique sensor and calls a 100-line repository prefix full. It supplies neither the informational/error state definition nor stable SDR identity, units, threshold masks, discrete-state interpretation, timestamps or WebUI correlation; fixed cipher and command-line password are unapproved.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly requires exact sensor semantics and a read-only UI/OOB comparison. V3.1 further separates label readability from the Project's Info-versus-Error state taxonomy, requires proof that any non-threshold discrete bits are decoded correctly and prevents the static page check from inheriting row 765's event-generation/SEL-full coverage.

original_test_intent: Confirm that the Sensor Page object associated with `SEL_InfoErr_Full` is readable in Dashboard and Server Health and that its exact current value or discrete Info/Error state, units/status and applicable thresholds match the versioned BMC sensor specification.
original_method: Identify the intended object using stable SDR metadata, read its complete value/state and threshold capabilities through an approved OOB/API path, capture the matching rows in both WebUI locations and compare them with Project SPEC. The written procedure does not authorize event injection, threshold changes or SEL capacity operations.
manual_activity: The platform owner maps the case label to the precise SDR/UI object and defines which decoded state constitutes Info versus Error and which thresholds are meaningful. The agent can collect read-only raw and WebUI evidence; an engineer resolves any vendor-specific state bits or display ambiguity and owns the verdict. No fault creation is authorized.
required_inputs: BMC/chassis/firmware/WebUI/SDR identity, trusted endpoint and read-only account role
Stable sensor number/name/type/entity/instance plus Dashboard and Server Health row/resource mapping
For analog data: expected reading, units, conversion/scaling, tolerance, status and threshold/hysteresis values; for discrete data: exact state-bit and Info/Error/severity meanings
Threshold capability/readability mask and rules for not-applicable, disabled, unavailable, stale or cached values
Validated ipmitool/API/browser versions, supported transport/cipher and protected authentication
Pinned immutable accessible `sensor.git` revision/checksum with command/secret/read-write/clear/retry review, or approved manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL or host logs; deletion is unrelated to the page check and removes the diagnostic events that may explain the current Info/Error state.
Do not assume the case label is an exact SDR name or choose the first substring match. Bind raw and UI evidence by stable sensor metadata and stop on missing, duplicate or inconsistent identities.

Do not force the data into analog threshold semantics. If the target is discrete, decode state bits and mark thresholds not applicable according to the specification rather than inventing numeric limits.
Do not truncate `sdr elist`, suppress errors or call an empty/missing record readable. Capture the exact full matching record, completion status, repository identity and timestamp.

Do not change thresholds, acknowledge/clear an alarm, inject an informational/error condition or reuse the dynamic row-765 evidence. This case is read-only and proves neither event generation nor SEL-full behavior.

Do not expose passwords with `-P`, assume cipher 17 or execute the inaccessible Script until a pinned revision is reviewed. Stop without automatic retry on unknown state bits, stale data, UI/raw disagreement or BMC instability.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target/client and the exact label-to-SDR/UI mapping; review the pinned Script if selected and collect repository identity, sensor capabilities, raw reading/state bits, status, thresholds and timestamp.
Capture the same object's Dashboard and Server Health representations without changing filters/settings, preserving refresh timestamps and any unavailable/not-applicable markers.
Apply the approved analog or discrete decoder, compare all applicable fields with Project SPEC and report absent, stale, differently rounded or semantically conflicting fields individually.
Repeat only the documented passive read needed to confirm freshness, not a failed command; preserve evidence and never clear, write, stimulate or issue DUT PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define the `SEL_InfoErr_Full` object and its Info-versus-Error taxonomy, explicitly distinguishing this static display row from dynamic row 765.
Approve expected analog/discrete fields, threshold applicability, units/scaling/tolerance/freshness and the reviewed Script or alternate tool.
Review raw/UI/spec discrepancies and issue the formal verdict or define a separate dynamic event testcase if required.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Only a possible read after exact identity and command safety are established. It assumes the label, exposes a secret, fixes cipher 17, truncates fallback output and omits UI/spec/state decoding, so it cannot prove full or correct Info/Error presentation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve the stable sensor identity and whether it is analog or discrete; capture the complete supported SDR/API object through protected access, decode its Info/Error state or reading/threshold fields with the firmware specification, and compare both unchanged WebUI views.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The `SEL_InfoErr_Full` label, Dashboard and Server Health paths, readability/spec Criteria, generic pre-clear, Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; no event stimulus or capacity behavior is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a firmware-bound read-only canonical object model that supports either analog thresholds or discrete Info/Error bits, then reconcile that object with both WebUI views and the Project field matrix.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact BMC firmware/SDR/WebUI combination whose `SEL_InfoErr_Full` label is mapped and decoded.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, SDR package, WebUI build, management client and pinned Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform SDR/sensor state specification, WebUI field definition and Project expected-state matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable identity, analog-versus-discrete semantics, capability-aware thresholds, freshness and full UI/OOB comparison while removing unrelated destructive setup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static state/readability proves no InfoErr stimulus, assert/deassert record, severity transition or SEL capacity handling. Those remain separate and unverified even if this snapshot is correct.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Object mapping, state/threshold decoder, expected fields/freshness, protected tool or reviewed Script and evidence rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A label may be synthetic rather than an SDR name; discrete state can be misreported as a numeric sensor; cached UI values and unsupported thresholds can create false mismatches.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use an approved Redfish/OEM sensor resource instead of ipmitool when it records the preserved command, actual interface/version, reason, engineer approval, field-level equivalence and any UI/ipmitool coverage not exercised. It cannot use this read-only override to claim row 765's dynamic InfoErr or SEL-capacity coverage.
expected_evidence: Target BMC/chassis, firmware/WebUI/SDR identities, trusted role and exact label-to-sensor/resource/UI-row map
Complete raw SDR/API record with number/type/entity, capability mask, analog reading or discrete bits, units/scaling, status, applicable thresholds/hysteresis and timestamp
Redacted Dashboard and Server Health captures/DOM tied to the same object and refresh interval
Approved Project matrix defining Info/Error meanings or analog values plus threshold applicability, tolerances, stale/NA/disabled handling and field-by-field result
Pinned Script commit/checksum/content review or signed alternate-method approval and protected command audit
No-clear/no-write/no-stimulus evidence, mismatch/limitation report, unchanged BMC health and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: For this Sensor Page row, Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently describe read-only visibility and specification comparison. The dynamic InfoErr ambiguity belongs to separate row 765; exact object/state mapping here is a resolvable Project/vendor input, not a contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A read-only display/spec purpose is clear. Sensor identity, analog/discrete decoder, expected states and Script content are supplyable readiness inputs, so execution is PACKAGE rather than permanently BLOCKED and remains gated until they are provided.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes YES to PACKAGE and rejects literal-name/truncated-output evidence absent state taxonomy, WebUI comparison and protected access.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on read-only hybrid classification while adding analog-versus-discrete capability handling, immutable Script governance and an explicit boundary against dynamic row-765 coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces command-output acceptance with stable object mapping, complete state/threshold decoding and two-view/spec evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_v3_1: Keeps row 765's engineer-blocked event-generation/SEL-full operation independent rather than importing or satisfying it with this snapshot.

review_improvement: Prevents a synthetic label, first-match SDR line or non-applicable threshold from being presented as a valid Info/Error sensor result, while preserving diagnostic state and accurately limiting coverage to read-only presentation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Info/Error may describe discrete event-state bits rather than a linear measured sensor. Therefore a correct review must first determine the object model and capability mask; otherwise numeric threshold output can look plausible but be meaningless. The WebUI and raw interface must resolve to the same stable object at a known refresh time, and no dynamic fault behavior can be inferred because the Master supplies no stimulus.
